entries.sum: An unsafe deserialization flaw in the blog server's XML-RPC endpoint lets an attacker run code with no login, in every release from 4.0.0 to 6.1.4. Apache says it is being actively exploited. It is the same bug as CVE-2026-82384, which had listed only 6.1.5.
entries.how: A crafted request to /roller-services/xmlrpc, reachable even when XML-RPC is switched off in the admin screen. A proof of concept has been public since 28 September.
tl: Apache widens it to 4.0.0–6.1.4 and confirms exploitation.
New reporting: Hackers Exploit Critical VMware, Cisco, and Apache Flaws as Espionage Attacks Emerge
entries.fix: Upgrade to 6.1.6 or later (6.1.7 recommended) or block the XML-RPC endpoint. Not yet on CISA's exploited list at the time of writing.

entries.t: JPMorgan Confirms Customer Data Breach Following Third-Party Compromise
entries.sum: Ransomware actor N0n has claimed attacks on JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard, reportedly leaking customer data on its dark web site
entries.how: Through a third party or supplier.

entries.t: Amazon says Chinese hackers used Cairn AI tool to discover apparent zero-day during attack on university
entries.sum: A China-linked threat actor used the open source AI penetration testing tool Cairn to persistently attack two universities, and in one case, possibly discover a zero-day bug, researchers said.

entries.t: WhatsApp Patches 3 Security Flaws, Including Android Bug Suspected of Use in Scams
entries.sum: Meta-owned WhatsApp has addressed security vulnerabilities, including one impacting its Android app that it suspects may have been exploited in connection with scam messages. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-23871 (CVSS score: 3.5), has been described as a case of incomplete validation of external ad-reply URLs in WhatsApp for Android and WhatsApp Business for Android before 2.26.17.4.

entries.t: Bell Canada says 'agentic' hacker stole enterprise customer data
entries.sum: Bell Canada has confirmed that an "agentic" threat actor breached its systems on November 17, 2026, and stole enterprise customer data, including information from a system used to order and provision telecommunications circuits. [...]

entries.t: Container Store restores systems after cyberattack
entries.sum: The firm’s parent company, Neighborhood Intelligence, said in a statement that The Container Store has “restored its website and systems following a cybersecurity incident this past weekend.”

entries.t: China's 'Armory Castle' Lays Siege to VMware vCenter Zero-Day
entries.sum: During the last wave of major VMware vCenter security updates, a China-nexus threat group likely already had its next zero-day up its sleeve.

entries.t: West Virginia Legislature hit with cyber incident affecting IT systems
entries.sum: A cybersecurity incident that began Thursday was still ongoing Friday in the West Virginia Legislature. A spokesperson said the disruption did not spread to other government entities.

entries.t: Dialing for Data: Inside the Com’s High-Profile Heists
entries.sum: Our analysis of Com affiliate vishing attacks, cloud data theft and extortion campaigns targeting healthcare and finance, with actionable defense guidance.

entries.t: CTO of ‘RansomwareHelp’ Indicted for Wire Fraud
entries.sum: The chief technology officer and co-founder of ransomwarehelp.com, a six year old Florida business that claimed to use "advanced cryptographic tools" to restore data locked by ransomware, has been charged with wire fraud after an FBI sting operation found the company was simply paying the attackers for a decryption key and charging victims a markup for work that was never performed.

entries.t: Attackers' AI Agents Found a Zero-Day in Medical-Imaging Software and Gained Root Access
entries.sum: Suspected China-linked hackers used autonomous AI agents to find a previously unknown flaw in MONAI Label, an open-source medical imaging server, and gain root access to a university server, Amazon Threat Intelligence said this week. The flaw allows an attacker with no account to write files outside the server's storage folder, and it affects MONAI Label 0.8.5 and earlier in the default setup,

entries.t: FBI reportedly hacked again, this time targeting nationwide police database
entries.sum: FBI systems have reportedly been breached for the second time in two months, this time targeting the agency's National Crime Information Center (NCIC), which is used to share information between local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies. [...]

entries.t: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
entries.sum: Microsoft is warning organizations that it suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information. [...]
